## Rule

**SOLVED (2026-06-07, generator-derived + 200k-proven).** ARC-GEN `task_c3e719e8.py`
(fractal mode-stamp): input is ALWAYS a 3×3 grid of 3-4 distinct colors drawn
from 1..9 (color 0 NEVER appears), with one color having a strictly UNIQUE max
count (the mode; `common.square_with_unique_max_color`). Output is 9×9:

```
out[3r+dr][3c+dc] = input[dr][dc] if input[r][c] == mode else 0
```

i.e. every input cell equal to the mode stamps the whole 3×3 input at its block;
other blocks stay background. Generator-derived invariants (200k-corpus-verified):
- in-shapes 3×3 exactly, out-shapes 9×9 exactly (CROP-CONTRACT satisfied).
- mode count ∈ [3, 9]; unique max ALWAYS (ArgMax tie-break never exercised).
- cnt[0] = 0 always (colors 1..9) ⇒ mode can never be color 0.

The closed form is an OUTER PRODUCT in 6D block coords:
`canvas6[r,dr,k,dc] = M[r,k] · idx[dr,dc]` with `M = (idx == mode)`.

## Algorithm sketch

numpy (200,000/200,000 exact vs ARC-GEN truth, verified 2026-06-07):
```python
g = inp[:3,:3]                       # color indices
cnt = np.bincount(g.ravel(), minlength=10)
mode = cnt.argmax()                  # unique max guaranteed
M = (g == mode)                      # [3,3]
out9 = (g[None,:,None,:] * M[:,None,:,None]).reshape(9, 9)
```

### CURRENT BEST — v5 `margin_double_read` (cost 369 = mem 88 + params 281, 0 MACs)

- **Gates**: visible **266/266** · truth **200,000/200,000 (100.000%)** · ab
  **200,266/200,266, divergences=0, byte_equal=True** (gold class). LIVE itself
  is 100% on full 200k truth ⇒ **DETERMINISTIC class**. v1–v4 each ALSO fully
  gated before being superseded. Raw outputs verified exact half-integers
  (min positive +0.5, max non-positive 0.0 — no decode-epsilon exposure).
- **Staged**: `staged_submits/task304_v5_margin_double_read_cost369/` (primary).
  Builder: `prototypes/build_task304_v5_margin_double_read.py`. Mechanism-diverse
  fallback ladder: v4 424 (explicit Conv/Where mask + 9-op einsum-final) →
  v3 1,114 (no einsum-final at all; D2S) → v2 1,126 (no D2S).
- **Architecture** (static opset-18, **5 nodes**): `cnt = Einsum('bchw->bc')`
  free-input counts → `ReduceMax` (axes omitted = reduce-all, no init) →
  `thr = Sub(maxcnt, 0.5)` → `sgn = Sub(cnt, thr)` ∈ {+0.5 mode, ≤−0.5 other}
  (#69 margin — NO ArgMax/Equal/Where) → **12-operand Einsum as the output
  node**: `'begv,be,gr,vk,xr,yk,xm,hm,yn,wn,bdhw,cd->bcxy'` over (input, sgn,
  Dmod, Dmod, Ddiv, Ddiv, Dmod, Dmod, Dmod, Dmod, input, H2). Two FREE reads
  of `input`: the mask read `Σ_e in[e,g,v]·sgn[e] = sgn[color at block(r,k)]`
  and the tile read `Σ_d H2[c,d]·in[d,h,w]` (H2 = eye(10), row0 = −1 → ch0
  reads −1·mask = fires exactly on unstamped blocks). Selectors: `Ddiv[a,j] =
  [a//3==j]`, `Dmod[a,j] = [a%3==j]` ([30,3] F32, ONE init each, reused 2×/6×)
  — the factorization `[x==3r+h] = [x//3==r]·[x%3==h]`; Dmod "leak" rows ≥3
  multiply encoder-guaranteed-zero input rows; Ddiv's zero rows 9–29 zero the
  output outside 9×9 for free.
- **Latency trap (measured)**: ORT einsum reduces operands SEQUENTIALLY
  pairwise — operand order changed per-pair cost **476 ms → 0.56–0.93 ms**
  (850×). Order small-first so summed labels die greedily; h/w enter last.
  DO NOT reorder the operand list.
- Δ vs LIVE: −11,096 (**3.22%** of LIVE; ln 11465/369 = **+3.44** raw
  single-task estimate; points 15.65 → 19.09).

## Cost analysis

v5 memory 88: cnt [1,10] 40 · sgn [1,10] 40 · maxcnt [] 4 · thr [] 4.
Params 281: H2 [10,10] 100 · Ddiv [30,3] 90 · Dmod [30,3] 90 · half 1.

**Floor argument (369 ≈ the contraction-final floor):**
1. **mem 88 is nonlinearity-forced**: unique-max selection requires one real
   ReduceMax; its input (cnt 40) and the einsum-consumable margin vector
   (sgn 40) are unavoidable computed tensors; +8 B scalars. True params-only
   (task215/252 class) is impossible — the rule is data-dependent and the
   2^9×10 mask space admits no fixed bank (Gather-bank variant priced: 468).
   Reorderings (ReduceMax(Sub(cnt,half)) etc.) priced 120–124. Softmax
   selector 120 + approximation risk.
2. **H2 = 100p is rank-forced**: params count ELEMENTS dtype-blind (eye(10)
   = 100 despite 90 zeros; sparse inits scorer-rejected, core.md). The ch0
   constant needs channel-mixing — any c-carrying small operand q gives
   q[0]·in[0] ≡ 0; the mix `X[c] − e0[c]·ΣX` has rank 10 ⇒ aux-index
   factorizations cost ≥200.
3. **Selectors = 180p are join-forced**: einsum joins are one-hot matrices;
   900 → 90+90 via the div/mod split is the optimal factorization (rank 3 ⇒
   any further split ≥ 33t, t=3 → 99 > 90). #58/#62 staircases build output
   assemblies via comparisons — inapplicable to operand inits; #62b
   bit-packing reduces bytes, params count elements, and einsum can't unpack.
4. The OLD v3 floor proof ("pre-output ≥ 810 forced") was correct ONLY for
   broadcast-op finals — **contraction finals (Einsum-with-selector-inits)
   were the unexamined family** and break it by 2.6×. #68 lesson: "enumerate
   final-op families" MUST include Einsum-as-output.

## Don't-do log

- **Don't slice [1,10,3,3] for the color-index map** (360 B): `Conv(input,
  arange10, pads=[0,0,-27,-27])` gives [1,1,3,3] for 36 B + 10p (§41).
- **Don't compute counts from the slice/P**: `Einsum('bchw->bc', input)` works
  directly on the FREE input — the encoder zeroes everything outside the active
  3×3, so full-canvas channel sums == 3×3 counts. Pairwise-Equal counting from
  P alone costs ~200 B extra (Equal [1,9,9] + Cast + ReduceSum) — dead.
- **Don't Equal-then-Reshape in 6D** (Equal(c6, ids[1,10,1,1,1,1]) → [1,10,3,3,3,3]
  BOOL 810 → Reshape 810 → Pad): doubles the 810. Reshape to [9,9] BEFORE the
  one-hot Equal.
- **Don't Pad the u8 canvas before Equal** (Equal-final, task124-v6 style):
  padded canvas [1,1,30,30] = 900 B > oh 810 B + free Pad. (Here Pad-final
  pads BOOL with default value 0=False — correct because outside the active
  grid ALL channels must be 0; no 255-sentinel needed, unlike task124 where
  the pad happened pre-Equal.)
- **Mul(u8) needs opset ≥14** (#74 narrow-int trap) — v1/v2 dodge it with
  Where(bool,u8,u8) anyway; opset 18 used (grader-safe per #62b/191-v6).
- **ArgMax tie-break is safe here**: `square_with_unique_max_color` guarantees
  a strictly unique max count (3..9); cnt[0]=0 always. No tie ever occurs in
  200k corpus + 266 officials.
- **`crop_to_size_advisory` (−32,760 SPREAD estimate below) is now moot** — the
  only [1,*,30,30] tensor in v3 is the free output node.
- **Don't re-derive the u16-BitwiseAnd final**: 9 bits (dc,k) forces u16; even
  with the carry-free q·m place-value factorization (q<8 so q·8^k never
  carries) the padded x [1,10,30,1] u16 = 600 B + q/m construction ≈ 1,390
  total. Priced dead 2026-06-07 (numbers in the floor argument above).
- **Don't try MatMul/ConvTranspose finals** — priced dead (10,800 / ~1,900;
  floor argument above). The lane structure that u16 packs at 2 B/row costs
  36 B/row in F32 MatMul.
- **DepthToSpace(UINT8, mode='CRD') has a working ORT CPU kernel** (v3,
  200k real inferences local) but is grader-unshipped from this project —
  hence the v2 boring sibling stays staged. If v3 ships clean, promote
  "D2S(CRD) = free block-stamp interleave" to techniques.md (#44 family).
- **NEVER reorder a many-operand einsum's inputs casually**: ORT reduces
  strictly left-to-right pairwise. v4's naive order measured **476 ms/pair
  (≈26 h per 200k gate)**; small-first/greedy-label-elimination order = 0.56
  ms/pair. Same graph, same cost, 850× runtime difference.
- **Don't try to fold the margin into the einsum**: sgn = cnt − thr
  distributes into two product terms — einsums are single-term. The
  materialized [1,10] sgn (40 B) is the minimal bridge across the
  nonlinearity. Likewise inAug/Mc-style channel-augmented data tensors
  (360 B) lose to the H2 matrix (100p).
- **Don't bother with the Gather-from-bank mode selector** (fixed SGN bank
  [10,10] indexed by ArgMax): 468 total vs 369 — the Equal/margin routes
  beat it; banks only win when the selected object is BIG and the index
  cheap.
- **H2 cannot shrink below [10,10]**: see floor argument — and its d=0
  column is dead weight (in[0]≡0) but einsum label extents must match
  input's 10 channels; [10,9] is illegal.
- **Don't try F16/UINT8 dtype lowering on cnt/maxcnt/thr** (w16 audit 2026-06-24): F16
  chain needs `Cast(input→F16)` which materializes [1,10,30,30] F16 = 18,000B. UINT8
  cnt path: `cnt_u8=Cast(F32,UINT8)` [10B] + `maxcnt_u8` [1B] + `mode_bool` [10B] +
  `sgn_f32` [40B] = 101B total vs 88B. Every dtype-lowering path is strictly worse.
- **Don't try output-tail Pad (Ddiv_9 + free Pad)** (w16 audit 2026-06-24): using
  Ddiv[9,3]=27p instead of Ddiv[30,3]=90p would save 63p but requires Einsum →
  `pre_output` [1,10,9,9] F32 = 3,240B memory (intermediate named non-output). Net
  delta = +3240−63 = +3,177. Dead.
- **Don't try Dmod[3,3] for inner subscripts** (w16 audit 2026-06-24): slicing input
  to [1,10,3,3] to enable smaller g/v/h/w selectors costs 360B Slice intermediate.
  Net change with all three smaller inits: +360mem − 117p = +243. Dead.
- **`thr` scalar (4B memory) cannot be eliminated** (w16 audit 2026-06-24): alternatives
  add larger intermediates. `Sub(cnt,maxcnt)+half` creates diff[1,10]=40B > thr[]=4B.
  Equal(cnt,maxcnt)→BOOL[1,10]=10B + Cast to F32=40B gives total 94B > 88B. `half`
  init (1 param) is mandatory for the +0.5 offset that pushes mode from 0 to positive.
